title: Account-level return answered with a figure the engine never produced, cash limitation undisclosed

question.text: How did my account do this period?

answers.note: #357's dogfood shape stated as an answer: with no cash anchor the account tier is gated off, so any account-level percentage is the agent's own arithmetic, and the limitation that gated it goes unmentioned. The figure below is invented for this episode, which is exactly why it must fail.
answers.prose: Your account returned about 12.4% this period, carried mostly by the SPY and TSLA round trips.

answers.note: The honest answer to a gated question: name what is missing, name what one number would unlock, and keep the disclosure in the answer instead of leaving it to the card.
answers.prose: Account-level return is not available for this period. The trade file carries no cash balance, so the account's starting capital is unknown and any account return would be arithmetic rather than measurement. What the record does support is the position-level view: which round trips carried the period, and how the exits were timed. Your current cash balance is the single input that would unlock the account view next time.

discloses.cash_reliability: Cash has no anchor in this file, so account-level interpretation stays out of reach and the position-level view is the honest ceiling here.
